cohort: The study included 443 pregnant women who underwent labor induction at Hospital Central de Maracaibo.
finding: Cervical funneling is a useful predictor for successful induction of labor in term pregnancies, associated with a shorter induction-delivery interval and a higher rate of vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Patients with cervical tunneling had a significantly higher rate of vaginal deliveries (87.5%) compared to those without tunneling (72.1%).
